tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded browser session demonstrates logging into Magento admin, navigating to the Manage Categories page, selecting category tree nodes, creating a subcategory, editing fields (name, url_key, is_active, include_in_menu, display_mode), creating a root category, and saving changes. The session recorded element_hash values for many interacted elements and discovered that selectors should prefer form#edit_form scoping and label-relative XPaths. Task Definition: Provide a reusable tool that automates these sequence: select a category node, optionally add a subcategory, optionally add a root category, edit canonical fields (name, URL key, is_active, include_in_menu, display_mode), save, and verify the save success message and tree update. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to the categories page. 2) Select given category node. 3) Optionally add subcategory: click Add Subcategory, fill name and options, save. 4) Optionally add root category: click Add Root Category, fill fields, save. 5) Optionally set/update url_key, is_active, include_in_menu, display_mode for current category. 6) Save category. 7) Extract success message and updated tree node. Variable Identification: category_node_name, create_subcategory, subcategory_name, create_root_category, root_category_name, set_url_key, set_is_active, set_include_in_menu, set_display_mode, store_view. Step Optimization: Replaced many UI interaction sequences with deterministic, label-driven XPath selectors and form#edit_form scoped selectors. Agent steps used only for conditional creation flows where the exact UI rendering may vary. Avoided unnecessary interactions like collapsing/expanding tree or inspecting product grid. Selectors chosen to be robust across Magento 1.x admin variations; prefer id/name/data-* where available; fallback to label-relative XPath. Additional notes: Assumes authenticated session; includes wait steps to ensure form rendering. This tool focuses only on the essential actions requested and avoids optional exploratory steps.
name: magento_manage_categories_tool
description: Automate common Magento 1.x admin category management tasks: select a category node, add subcategory or root category, edit category fields (name, url_key, is_active, include_in_menu, display_mode), and save the category. Uses label-driven XPaths and id/name-based selectors scoped to form#edit_form where available. The agent is expected to be already authenticated.

steps.description: Open the Magento Admin Manage Categories page (assumes authenticated session).
Select the category node by its exact visible label text in the category tree.
Wait briefly for the category edit form to load and populate after selecting node.
Create and save a subcategory with provided fields when requested. Uses label-driven selectors scoped to form#edit_form.
steps.task: If {create_subcategory} is true: Click 'Add Subcategory', wait for form#edit_form to appear, then set Name to {subcategory_name}, set Is Active to {set_is_active} if provided, set Include in Navigation Menu to {set_include_in_menu} if provided, then click Save Category. Otherwise skip.

steps.description: Create and save a root category when requested.
steps.task: If {create_root_category} is true: Click the 'Add Root Category' control, wait for New Root Category form to appear, set Name to {root_category_name}, set Is Active to {set_is_active} if provided, set Include in Navigation Menu to {set_include_in_menu} if provided, then click Save Category. Otherwise skip.

steps.description: Set the URL Key in the edit form if {set_url_key} provided; relies on form#edit_form input[name='url_key'] presence.
Click the Save Category button to persist changes.
Wait for the save to complete and for success message to appear.
Confirm 'The category has been saved.' message and return the updated tree node details.
steps.goal: Verify save by extracting the success message and capture the new/updated category node text and attributes (data-category-id/title) from the category tree.

input_schema.name: category_node_name
input_schema.description: Exact visible label text of the category node to select from the tree (e.g. 'Accessories (62)' or 'Default Category (1896)')

input_schema.name: create_subcategory
input_schema.description: If true, add a subcategory under the selected category. If false, do not add a subcategory.

input_schema.name: subcategory_name
input_schema.description: Name of the subcategory to create (required if create_subcategory is true).

input_schema.name: create_root_category
input_schema.description: If true, open Add Root Category form and create a root category with provided name.

input_schema.name: root_category_name
input_schema.description: Name of the root category to create (required if create_root_category is true).

input_schema.name: set_url_key
input_schema.description: URL Key to set for the category being edited (if field present).

input_schema.name: set_is_active
input_schema.description: Set Is Active value. Use '1' for Yes and '0' for No. If omitted, current value is left unchanged.

input_schema.name: set_include_in_menu
input_schema.description: Set Include in Navigation Menu value. Use '1' for Yes and '0' for No. If omitted, current value is left unchanged.

input_schema.name: set_display_mode
input_schema.description: Display Mode option visible text to set (e.g. 'Products only', 'Static block and products').

input_schema.name: store_view
input_schema.description: Store view to switch to before editing (e.g. 'All Store Views', 'English'). Optional.
